answer: Random beacon spot-checks plus a heartbeat block mass fakes. Each agent posts a 300 POA bond and emits a heartbeat signal proving live work. A public beacon samples 5% at random; one failing it loses its bond, returned only in shale layers, one thin layer per honest epoch. Faking 100 identities costs 30,000 POA in bonds plus 5,000 POA of compute a round, against a few POA per fake. An honest agent pays once and keeps its rewards undiluted.
